worker_target_description: ABC Support practice-based replication, randomized multiple-baseline design across four Grade 2 students; row-specific outcome/test unresolved.
worker_notes: Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. No original primary source was assigned or consulted. Page 8 has distinct baseline-versus-intervention tests: training WCPM average bias-corrected g = 3.59, p = .042; non-training WCPM average g = 2.06, p = .25. Both also have follow-up comparisons (g = 2.88 and 1.50, respectively; each p = .042). The supplied outcome description does not choose among outcomes; no mapping by row order or numeric matching was made. Common design sample candidate is four students, directly stated, not derived from degrees of freedom; repeated observations are not participant N. This candidate is retained only for parent field-scope review. All four referred students met screening criteria (section 4.2); no participant exclusion from the four-student critical design is described.

coding_context.description: "..integrated supplemental intervention for early elementary students [...] (produces) significant improvement from baseline to intervention for both reading and behavior outcomes."
coding_context.reported_success_quote: In concert with prior empirical findings on ABC Support, analyses revealed improvement from baseline to intervention for both reading and behavior outcomes, as well as from baseline to follow-up assessments.

prior_adjudication.quote: despite the across-student mean increase in WCPM level from the baseline phase (M = 45.8) to the intervention phase (M = 56.7), with an average g of 2.06 and an average NAP of 0.82, a randomization test of that increase was not statistically significant (p = .25).
prior_adjudication.reason: The neutral locator (locators_o 'p.24-25' from an unmapped manuscript pagination not present in the 19-page published original article, locators_r 'p.8', and description 'Reading and behavior outcomes at baseline versus intervention...') does not uniquely distinguish among the three baseline-to-intervention outcomes reported on p. 8 of the published private-Drive replication PDF: training reading passages ('statistically significant (p = .042) increases in WCPM on training passages from baseline to intervention (M = 48.9 and 76.8, respectively; average g = 3.59; average NAP = 0.97)'), standard non-training passages ('not statistically significant (p = .25)', where 'an intervention effect could not be disentangled from the improvement (i.e., upward trend) apparent in each student’s baseline performance'), and engaged behavior ('not statistically significant (p = .29)'). Because target identity cannot be established without relying on numerical coincidence and the individual baseline-to-intervention outcomes on p. 8 have divergent statistical and narrative conclusions, the overall study label cannot be transferred.
